title: Lekalo PHP Operations Evidence
description: Closed contract for the observed-handler evidence document the checked and custom mode join consumes (issue #59). The document is produced outside the compiler by a controlled producer (the pinned external analyzer lane) and staged under `.lekalo/import/observed/operations-evidence.json`; the adapter only validates its shape and digests and joins it against the declared operations. Presence of a document with plausible digests is never trusted as producer execution: the producer receipt reference must validate, and a missing, stale, ambiguous or partial record is a typed finding - never a pass, never a silent rewrite. The document is pure data - no credentials, hosts, URLs, users, wall-clock timestamps, or provider output.

irDigest.description: The IR evidence digest the observation was produced against; a stale digest makes every record unknown.

operationsInputDigest.description: The operations input document digest the observation was produced against.

producer.description: The controlled producer receipt: the tool, its pinned version, and the exact receipt document the run recorded. The join validates the reference but never fabricates execution.

sources.description: The complete observed source inventory, path-sorted; every operation record's path must appear here with the identical digest.

operations.description: One record per observed operation entrypoint, sorted by id.

path.description: The case-preserving native path as observed; the join lowercases only for the wire.

digest.description: The sha256 of the exact observed source bytes.

constructor.description: The observed constructor slots in declared order, each with its resolved property type identity.

type.description: The resolved type identity (FQN or builtin spelling).

parameters.description: The observed entrypoint parameters in declared order.

returnType.description: The observed return type identity, `void` or `never` inclusive.

publicMethods.description: Every public method name of the observed class, sorted; a second business entrypoint is a finding.
